issuer: the North Carolina Division of Motor Vehicles (NCDMV)
note: The NC Driver Handbook (read 2026-10-30; its fees are those of the quadrennial adjustment of 1 July 2024) gives the Class C licence at $6.50 a year and its duration as 8 years when issued at 18 to 65, so the licence is kept as 8 years at $52 ($6.50 times 8, a product of the handbook's figures). It says drivers under 18 are provisional licensees and that at 18 an eligible driver may upgrade to a regular Class C licence, so a full licence is kept from 18. The state ID page gives the card free from 17 ($16.75 under 17), so the card is kept from 17 at no fee; its term wasn't read and is null. Not held: the 5-year licence from 66.
